scope: Complete selected protocol outputs, all direct-search hits/scores, every selected message/tool result, all named-wire response bytes, native endpoint responses, provenance rows, failure attempts, actual scripts and patches. The tables in the companion document are additional summaries.
redactions: Private addresses, actual OS/SSH account/hostnames and private registry organization replaced consistently.
Actual Secret values scanned in memory only; matches, if any, replaced and counted per file.

Full original/forwarded model request bodies and agent event traces include proprietary system prompts and are retained in the private archive. Selected generated answers/messages, complete wire response bytes and all runtime result fields remain public after identity/credential redaction.
excludedFromPublic: Credentials, raw Helm values/manifests/server render and private child-chart package stay on Spark under protected permissions.
Complete agent event/request traces, original raw-completion inputs and tokenizer IDs include proprietary system prompts and remain in the internal evidence bundle.

Whole browser DOM/screenshots, full all-alert snapshots and unrelated private events stay in the internal bundle. The full selected test alert and complete selected session/tool records are included; unrelated page content stays private.
